column4: (2)  Every  regulation  made  by  the  Minister  shall  be

column3: published  in  the Gazette  and  shall  come  into  operation  on

column4: (3) Every regulation made by the Minister shall, as soon

column3: as convenient after its publication in the Gazette, be brought
